summary: Birthday Feature System - Comprehensive Testing Complete. All 7 backend APIs tested and passing (26/26 tests). Frontend components verified: Birthday Wishes Page, Birthday Celebration elements visible on dashboard, admin wishes rendering correctly with beautiful gradient card templates. Card templates API returns all 18 templates as expected.

minor.issue: Multiple admin wishes created when called multiple times (no idempotency check)
User 'age' shows 0 because birthday was set to today's full datetime instead of birth year

issues: Spin the Wheel modal appears on top of birthday content - may obscure birthday celebration popup on first login

critical_code_review_comments: Birthday feature is fully functional and well-implemented
All 7 birthday API endpoints working correctly: card-templates, my-birthday-status, my-wishes, my-gifts, upcoming-birthdays, send-wish, send-gift, check-birthdays
18 card templates available with proper gradient styling
10% birthday discount auto-applied and stored in discounts collection
Admin automatically sends birthday wish from 'Team Calliotel' with proper notification
BirthdayWishesPage displays wishes with beautiful gradient card designs
Minor: check-birthdays endpoint lacks idempotency - calling it multiple times creates duplicate admin wishes (5+ currently in DB)
